set.rappels: A few rappels over the top of the spire into the descent gully between Whine Spire and the west summit of Silver Star, then a few more in the gully between long sections of loose 4th-class downclimbing. No exact count is published, so carry a rope and gear for several rappels and cord to build anchors.
set.rappel_count_note: No party has published a station-by-station count for this descent, so none is listed here. Both halves are described the same way, as a few rappels: first over the top of the spire, then intermittently in the gully. Expect to find or build your own anchors in loose rock rather than bolted stations.
set.descent_text: The descent does not reverse the route. Make a few rappels over the top of the spire into the steep gully between Whine Spire and the west summit of Silver Star, then work down the gully with long sections of loose 4th-class downclimbing and a few more rappels. The gully is extremely loose, with rock coming down through it constantly, so keep the party out of one another's fall line and clear of the ropes. Do not attempt it in rock shoes. Plan on 2.5 to 3 hours in good conditions; parties benighted here describe about three hours of complex route-finding in the dark, and advise against starting it after dark.
